ai_summary: ADF Foods' subsidiary has settled a litigation, agreeing to accept a reduced US$1.75 million plus interest, down from original judgments of US$2.31 million, with an initial US$450,000 received. While preserving critical intellectual property rights and securing an appeal withdrawal, the balance of US$1.30 million is structured over a maximum of 52 monthly installments, introducing collection risk and significantly delaying full monetary recovery.
